exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Formal passive constructions in legal writing

items.prompt: All termination procedures ___ reviewed in accordance with local statute.
items.hintAfterError: Estrutura legal: be + to + be + particípio; 'procedures' é plural.

items.prompt: It is generally ___ that principles must be consistent.
Grievances ___ handled by qualified local counsel.
items.hintAfterError: Depois do modal vem 'be' na forma base + particípio.

items.prompt: Non-discrimination principles must be ___ without exception.
items.hintAfterError: Verbo irregular: o particípio segue o padrão de 'hold'.
